notes.title: Patch 1.2.86

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6

[list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.4
notes.notes:
[b]Important Changes:[/b]
Moved the system menu away from the character menu. Now you can access it exclusively by hitting escape/[Cancel] buttons.
Save and Load game menus have been combined into one. Interchangeable by button press during gameplay. From the title screen, only loading is available.
Certain cinematic scenes no longer require navigating to UI buttons. These are now using specific controller buttons to interact.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed tavern visibility of Harlow after recruiting Countess Loveshanks.
Fixed navigation issue with delete buttons in the save game menu.
Fixed navigation around main menu options. controller navigation should be much smoother now.
Fixed resolution dropdown text, options are no longer blank.
Fixed control rebinding functionality. Also navigation no longer locks out controls after closing the rebind menu.
Fixed readability of many UI/text elements on smaller resolutions.
Added Steam Deck controller icons that will show when playing on the device.
Added Xbox/PS5/Switch controller icons that will show when respective controllers are detected.
Removed keyboard user specific language from tutorials.
Fixed a deep issue that was causing bad comparisons in the progress system. This was impacting a very large amount of things.
Fixed Brother Lyustus in the tavern. He is no longer stuck in the floor or walking at weird heights.
Fixed an issue preventing selected resolutions from being set on game load.
Fixed an animation loop stutter in Kara Aven's prison scene.

[b]Other Stuff:[/b]
Updated the game credits with recent additions.
Changed screen position of interaction options during sex scenes, also any cinematic that shows the "hold to skip" message.
Adjusted default width scaling of dialog windows. Should be more consistent across resolutions now.
Revised some cinematic layouts to try and prevent image cutoff on widescreen resolutions.
